text:
**Earwax Cupcakes, Rise and Shine**

*(Verse 1)*  
In the land of wax and sweet delight,  
Kitchens where little waxheads take flight.  
Tailor-made ears, in a chorus of light,  
Earwax cupcakes in waxy night.

*(Pre-Chorus)*  
Whipped cream dreams on a cloud of sugar  
To-die-for tummy snug and hug-happy  
Sweet as the honey secretion that's gathered,  
Earwax cupcakes—our little treasure!

*(Chorus)*  
Earwax cupcakes, catch the thrill,  
Dive into a crispy, chewy, and tart-filled reel.  
Earwax cupcakes, you're our delight,  
In the heart of the sweetest ear socket night!

*(Verse 2)*  
Clouds of wax, sugar bakes, and yummy dreams,  
Feast on a mission to chase the sweethearts, teams.  
Soft and sticky, in a sugary esteem,  
Earwax cupcakes, oh so supreme!

*(Pre-Chorus)*  
Whipped cream dreams on a cloud of sugar  
To-die-for tummy snug and hug-happy  
Sweet as the honey secretion that's gathered,  
Earwax cupcakes—our little treasure!

*(Chorus)*  
Earwax cupcakes, catch the thrill,  
Dive into a crispy, chewy, and tart-filled reel.  
Earwax cupcakes, you're our delight,  
In the heart of the sweetest ear socket night!

*(Bridge)*  
Earwax cupcakes, dancing high,  
Earwax cupcakes, you’ll make us sigh.  
In this sweet mélange, let’s just sink or float,  
Earwax cupcakes, no turning back!

*(Chorus)*  
Earwax cupcakes, catch the thrill,  
Dive into a crispy, chewy, and tart-filled reel.  
Earwax cupcakes, you're our delight,  
In the heart of the sweetest ear socket night!

*(Outro)*  
So here’s to a sweet voyage without a fight,  
Through the night, through the day, through the morning light.  
Earwax cupcakes, the sugar in sight,  
Earwax cupcakes, our little delight!
